require_relative "lib/auth"
require_relative "lib/user"
require_relative "lib/dynamic"
require_relative "lib/shapes"
require "json"

module Tools
  def self.run(arg)
    greet(arg)
    Auth.check(arg)
    [arg].map(&:norm)
  end

  def self.greet(x)
    puts x
  end

  def self.unused_tool; end
end

class Report
  def initialize(data)
    @data = data
  end

  def to_s
    format_it
  end

  def format_it
    @data.to_json
  end

  def never_used
    1
  end

  def self.build
    new({})
  end
end

Tools.run(ARGV[0])
puts Report.build
Dispatcher.new.go("a")
Circle.new.area(2)
Circle.new.label
